name: list_devices
description: List all available iOS simulators and devices

name: boot_simulator
description: Boot a simulator by UDID Supply deviceId (or legacy udid); both must agree if provided.

deviceId.description: Short deviceId, full UDID, or exact unique device name. Required unless legacy udid is supplied.

name: shutdown_simulator
description: Shutdown a simulator by UDID Supply deviceId (or legacy udid); both must agree if provided.

deviceId.description: Short deviceId, full UDID, or exact unique device name. Required unless legacy udid is supplied.

name: tap
description: Tap at specific coordinates on the screen Pass screenshotId to use returned-image pixel coordinates with automatic conversion. Without screenshotId, coordinates and distances use simulator points.

screenshotId.description: Optional ID from screenshot. Coordinates (plus scroll distance, default 200, and pinch radius, default 100) then use pixels of that returned image; MCP converts automatically. Without it, use simulator points. Recapture after rotation, navigation or device switching.

deviceId.description: Short deviceId, full udid, or exact unique device name from list_devices. MCP connects automatically. Can be omitted with a valid screenshotId or a single previously used device. Chains bind one device for their entire duration.

description: Scroll by swiping from the supplied start point. Direction describes finger movement, not content movement. Pass screenshotId to use returned-image pixel coordinates with automatic conversion. Without screenshotId, coordinates and distances use simulator points.

direction.description: Finger movement direction: up decreases Y, down increases Y, left decreases X, right increases X.

distance.description: Distance in the same coordinate units as x1/y1 (default: 200)

name: pinch
description: Perform a native simultaneous two-finger pinch around x/y. Scale is final finger separation divided by initial separation: >1 spreads fingers (zoom in), <1 brings them together (zoom out). The app decides its actual zoom and limits. No single-finger approximation. Requires native idb pinch support. Pass screenshotId to use returned-image pixel coordinates with automatic conversion. Without screenshotId, coordinates and distances use simulator points.

radius.description: Initial distance of each finger from the center, in the same units as x/y (default 100). Choose a center/radius so the gesture fits the screen.

screenshotId.description: Optional ID from screenshot. Coordinates (plus scroll distance, default 200, and pinch radius, default 100) then use pixels of that returned image; MCP converts automatically. Without it, use simulator points. Recapture after rotation, navigation or device switching.

name: screenshot
description: Take a screenshot only, without reading accessibility. Default mode pixel: original native dimensions, regardless of saved mode. Explicit mode can request logical or both. Images are returned in content and metadata in structuredContent. Single mode: {screenshotId, mode, imageSize, deviceInfo: {deviceId, screenSize, scale}}. Both: {images: [logical metadata, pixel metadata]}. screenSize is in logical points; imageSize in pixels. Pass screenshotId with image-pixel coordinates to gestures for conversion. References expire after 5 minutes, newest 20 per device; recapture after rotation/navigation. Default PNG, 5 MB per image; never silently resize to meet the byte limit. Format, quality and maxBytes use saved settings unless overridden for this call.

mode.description: Defaults to pixel (original dimensions); logical and both are explicit overrides.

format.description: PNG (default) preserves UI text without lossy compression. JPEG can save bandwidth.

quality.description: JPEG quality only; ignored for PNG.

maxBytes.description: Default 5000000 (5 MB) per image. Maximum encoded image bytes BEFORE Base64 (~4/3 expansion). Returns an error if the requested dimensions cannot fit; never silently resizes.

path.description: Optional original PNG output path. Explicit paths are not auto-deleted; otherwise managed history retention applies.

deviceId.description: Short deviceId, full udid, or exact unique device name from list_devices. MCP connects automatically. Can be omitted with a valid screenshotId or a single previously used device. Chains bind one device for their entire duration.

name: capture
description: Capture the screen and all accessibility elements. Default mode logical (or saved setup mode). Top-level elements includes label, title, value, identifier, role, type, enabled, frame and center. Both mode includes one elements list alongside images. Element frames and centers ALWAYS use logical points: tap center with the same deviceId WITHOUT screenshotId. Image and accessibility reads are sequential, not atomic; centers do not guarantee visibility or tappability. Accessibility failure preserves images with elements:null and elementsError. Images are returned in content and metadata in structuredContent. Single mode: {screenshotId, mode, imageSize, deviceInfo: {deviceId, screenSize, scale}}. Both: {images: [logical metadata, pixel metadata]}. screenSize is in logical points; imageSize in pixels. Pass screenshotId with image-pixel coordinates to gestures for conversion. References expire after 5 minutes, newest 20 per device; recapture after rotation/navigation. Default PNG, 5 MB per image; never silently resize to meet the byte limit. Format, quality and maxBytes use saved settings unless overridden for this call.

mode.description: Defaults to saved mode (logical initially); pixel or both are optional overrides.

format.description: PNG (default) preserves UI text without lossy compression. JPEG can save bandwidth.

quality.description: JPEG quality only; ignored for PNG.

maxBytes.description: Default 5000000 (5 MB) per image. Maximum encoded image bytes BEFORE Base64 (~4/3 expansion). Returns an error if the requested dimensions cannot fit; never silently resizes.

path.description: Optional original PNG output path. Explicit paths are not auto-deleted; otherwise managed history retention applies.
